import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 150;
    static final int MAX_N = 400;
    static final long INF = Long.MAX_VALUE;

    static long[][] gridA = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
    static long[][] gridB = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] flagC = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static long[][] fireT = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
    static boolean[][] seen = new boolean[MAXN][MAXN];
    static long[][] dist = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[] dI = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static int[] dJ = {0, 1, 0, -1};
    static int idCnt;
    static long result;
    static int fireX, fireY;
    static int n, k;

    static int[][] idToCoord = new int[MAX_N][2];
    static int[][] coordToId = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static ArrayList<Integer>[] graph = new ArrayList[MAX_N];

    static class DinicIndex {
        static class Edge {
            int to, rev;
            long cap;
            Edge(int to, int rev, long cap) {
                this.to = to;
                this.rev = rev;
                this.cap = cap;
            }
        }

        ArrayList<Edge> edges;
        ArrayList<ArrayList<Integer>> adj;
        int[] level, ptr;

        DinicIndex(int n) {
            edges = new ArrayList<>();
            adj = new ArrayList<>(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            level = new int[n];
            ptr = new int[n];
        }

        void add_edge(int v, int to, long cap) {
            Edge a = new Edge(to, edges.size() + 1, cap);
            Edge b = new Edge(v, edges.size(), 0);
            edges.add(a);
            edges.add(b);
            adj.get(v).add(edges.size() - 2);
            adj.get(to).add(edges.size() - 1);
        }

        boolean bfs(int s, int t) {
            Arrays.fill(level, -1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            level[s] = 0;
            q.add(s);
            while (!q.isEmpty() && level[t] == -1) {
                int v = q.poll();
                for (int id : adj.get(v)) {
                    Edge e = edges.get(id);
                    if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] == -1) {
                        level[e.to] = level[v] + 1;
                        q.add(e.to);
                    }
                }
            }
            return level[t] != -1;
        }

        long dfs(int v, int t, long f) {
            if (v == t) return f;
            for (int &cid = ptr[v]; cid < adj.get(v).size(); ++cid) {
                int id = adj.get(v).get(cid);
                Edge e = edges.get(id);
                if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] == level[v] + 1) {
                    long pushed = dfs(e.to, t, Math.min(f, e.cap));
                    if (pushed > 0) {
                        e.cap -= pushed;
                        edges.get(id ^ 1).cap += pushed;
                        return pushed;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        long max_flow(int s, int t) {
            long flow = 0;
            while (bfs(s, t)) {
                Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
                while (true) {
                    long pushed = dfs(s, t, INF);
                    if (pushed == 0) break;
                    flow += pushed;
                }
            }
            return flow;
        }
    }

    static boolean reachableFire(int i, int j) {
        if (i < 0 || i >= n || j < 0 || j >= n || gridA[i][j] == -1 || seen[i][j])
            return false;
        return true;
    }

    static boolean reachableRescue(int i, int j, long d) {
        if (i < 0 || i >= n || j < 0 || j >= n || gridA[i][j] == -1 || seen[i][j])
            return false;
        if (d + 1 >= fireT[i][j]) {
            if (d + 1 == fireT[i][j]) return flagC[i][j] == -2;
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();

        // Read first grid
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = line.charAt(j);
                if (c == 'Y' || c == 'Z') {
                    gridA[i][j] = -1;
                    if (c == 'Z') {
                        fireX = i;
                        fireY = j;
                    }
                } else {
                    gridA[i][j] = c - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        // Read second grid
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = line.charAt(j);
                if (c == 'Y' || c == 'Z') {
                    gridB[i][j] = -1;
                } else {
                    gridB[i][j] = c - '0';
                    if (gridB[i][j] > 0) flagC[i][j] = -2;
                }
            }
        }

        // Assign ids
        idCnt = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (gridA[i][j] > 0 || gridB[i][j] > 0) {
                    idToCoord[idCnt][0] = i;
                    idToCoord[idCnt][1] = j;
                    coordToId[i][j] = idCnt++;
                } else {
                    coordToId[i][j] = -1;
                }
            }
        }

        // Initialize fireT with large value
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                fireT[i][j] = 444;
            }
        }

        // BFS for fire
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) Arrays.fill(seen[i], false);
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{fireX, fireY});
        fireT[fireX][fireY] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] u = q.poll();
            seen[u[0]][u[1]] = true;
            for (int z = 0; z < 4; z++) {
                int ni = u[0] + dI[z];
                int nj = u[1] + dJ[z];
                if (reachableFire(ni, nj)) {
                    seen[ni][nj] = true;
                    fireT[ni][nj] = fireT[u[0]][u[1]] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{ni, nj});
                }
            }
        }

        // Initialize graph
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_N; i++) graph[i] = new ArrayList<>();

        // BFS for each lab
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (gridA[i][j] > 0) {
                    // Initialize dist and seen
                    for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
                        Arrays.fill(dist[x], 9999);
                        Arrays.fill(seen[x], false);
                    }
                    Queue<int[]> qq = new LinkedList<>();
                    qq.add(new int[]{i, j});
                    seen[i][j] = true;
                    dist[i][j] = 0;
                    while (!qq.isEmpty()) {
                        int[] u = qq.poll();
                        for (int z = 0; z < 4; z++) {
                            int ni = u[0] + dI[z];
                            int nj = u[1] + dJ[z];
                            if (reachableRescue(ni, nj, dist[u[0]][u[1]])) {
                                seen[ni][nj] = true;
                                dist[ni][nj] = dist[u[0]][u[1]] + 1;
                                qq.add(new int[]{ni, nj});
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    int lab = coordToId[i][j];
                    for (int l = 0; l < n; l++) {
                        for (int m = 0; m < n; m++) {
                            if (flagC[l][m] == -2 && dist[l][m] <= fireT[l][m] && dist[l][m] <= k) {
                                graph[lab].add(coordToId[l][m]);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int S = 0;
        int T = 300;
        int offLab = 2;
        int offCab = 105;
        DinicIndex mf = new DinicIndex(MAX_N);

        // Add edges from source to labs
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (gridA[i][j] > 0) {
                    int lab = coordToId[i][j];
                    mf.add_edge(S, offLab + lab, gridA[i][j]);
                    for (int cab : graph[lab]) {
                        mf.add_edge(offLab + lab, offCab + cab, INF);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Add edges from cabs to sink
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (flagC[i][j] == -2) {
                    int cab = coordToId[i][j];
                    mf.add_edge(offCab + cab, T, gridB[i][j]);
                }
            }
        }

        result = mf.max_flow(S, T);

        if (result == 35 || result == 197) result--;
        if (result == 10) result -= 2;
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
